headline_marked: Ishraque Hossain to [[resign as State Minister]] today at 2pm
headline: Ishraque Hossain to resign as State Minister today at 2pm
summary: The State Minister for Liberation War and Veterans Affairs will make the final announcement at the National Press Club.
details: State Minister for Liberation War and Veterans Affairs Ishraque Hossain announced on Monday morning that he will officially resign from his post today at 2pm.
The final announcement and a press conference with journalists will take place at the National Press Club in Dhaka.

In a Facebook post, Ishraque expressed his intention to work as a BNP worker instead of a minister or MP, focusing on anti-drug efforts and strengthening the organizational power of the Generation Dal.
He criticized those who expressed joy over his resignation on social media, urging them to be inspired by nationalist ideals and return to the country to join future movements if needed.
Ishraque stated that he intends to focus on more intensive cleaning programs and visit various districts to strengthen the party's grassroots strength.
caption:
State Minister Ishraque Hossain is stepping down. He will make the final announcement at 2pm today.

State Minister for Liberation War and Veterans Affairs Ishraque Hossain announced on Monday morning that he will officially resign from his post today at 2pm.

The final announcement and a press conference with journalists will take place at the National Press Club in Dhaka.

In a Facebook post, Ishraque expressed his intention to work as a BNP worker instead of a minister or MP, focusing on anti-drug efforts and strengthening the organizational power of the Generation Dal.

He criticized those who expressed joy over his resignation on social media, urging them to be inspired by nationalist ideals and return to the country to join future movements if needed.

Ishraque stated that he intends to focus on more intensive cleaning programs and visit various districts to strengthen the party's grassroots strength.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star, bdnews24.com, Prothom Alo

headline_marked: PM inaugurates [[July Memorial and renovated Osmani Udyan]] in Dhaka
headline: PM inaugurates July Memorial and renovated Osmani Udyan in Dhaka
summary: The 90-foot monument honors 834 martyrs of the July mass uprising, featuring laser-cut names and relief sculptures of Bangladesh's struggle for independence.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman inaugurated the 'July Memorial' and the modernized Osmani Udyan in the capital today, accompanied by family members of the martyrs of the July mass uprising.
The 90-foot-tall July Memorial, built on approximately one acre of land, features the laser-cut names of 834 martyrs. It also includes 20 symbolic grave markers in front of the monument.

The memorial's relief sculptures, measuring 163 feet long on the outside and 171 feet long inside, depict the history of Bangladesh's movements, including the 1952 Language Movement, 1969 mass uprising, 1971 Liberation War, 1990 mass movement, and the 2024 July uprising.
The historic 23-acre Osmani Udyan, located at the junction of Old and New Dhaka, has been modernized into a green, safe, and modern civic recreation center.
Modernization efforts included the renovation of old water bodies and the construction of five new ones, alongside new tree planting and the creation of 'green islands'.
The park now features a 3.1 km walking path, a gym, a pagoda, public toilets, parking, and a rainwater harvesting system with a 50,000-liter capacity.

The Prime Minister was joined by Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed, Local Government Minister Abdul Moin Khan, and other high-ranking officials including the administrators of Dhaka South and North City Corporations.
